title: How to chat with Google support
description: Not finding all the help you need with Google support? Why not let the ad optimization experts help. Sign up with MonetizeMore today: https://www.monetizemore.com/sign-up?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=how-to-chat-with-google-support-vid&utm_adgroup=joz  Remember to subscribe to our YouTube channel so that you never miss a video!  Find more ad optimization tips over at our blog: https://www.monetizemore.com/blog/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=how-to-chat-with-google-support-vid&utm_adgroup=joz  #MonetizeMore #GoogleSupport #Publisher

asr.full_text: Hey guys, so today I'm going to show you how to contact Google Support. While you're logged in either on your AdSense account, Ad Exchange, or Google Ad Manager account, you can click on the help icon on the upper right hand corner of your screen. Scroll down to the very bottom. You're going to see support options. In here, you have to specify the issue or the specific category you're having challenges with, for example. And let's say it's related to reports. Then, select another category that's relevant to your issue let's say discrepancies it's gonna give you suggestions or different links that can possibly answer or address your issue and select one of them then try to resolve using the guide that they have in here if no avail tail not resolved you have two options at the very bottom you can see email support or we can also chat with a support specialist. So if you select chat, you will have to fill out the form in here to chat with them. So specify your first name, your email address, and select the product you're having issues with. if its TFP, which is currently called Google Ad Manager, or Ad Exchange. Once that's done, you can specify your issue or describe the issue or question that you have in here, and just click on submit. And you will now be able to speak with one of the Google support. Now here's the caveat. Not all publisher accounts can be supported via chat, but if you work with MonetizeMore, MonetizeMore is 100% supported and we can go ahead and talk to them if in case there are issues and get the direct response or direct support from google. Thanks for joining us today! We hope you enjoyed our presentation. Also, learn to monetize more by watching our tutorial series and reading our latest ad optimization tips. Please subscribe to our blog to receive periodic updates. Thanks. We'll catch you next time.

textual.observation: The video promotes signing up with MonetizeMore and links that relationship to a claim that MonetizeMore accounts receive full support access and that MonetizeMore can contact Google on the viewer's behalf.

evidence.quote: if you work with MonetizeMore, MonetizeMore is 100% supported and we can go ahead and talk to them if in case there are issues and get the direct response or direct support from google

textual.context: Promotional context; the source also presents ordinary instructions for contacting Google Support. The relationship between signing up and the stated support access is described by the speaker, but its exact terms are unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: The requested sign-up is linked to an absolute support-access claim and an asserted ability to obtain direct Google support for the viewer, requiring later assessment of the claim and its conditions.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether MonetizeMore has the stated support relationship with Google, what "100% supported" means, whether support is guaranteed, or what obligations or costs apply to signing up.

textual_context_notes.observation: The video explains how to use Google account support options, including selecting a category, using provided guides, and submitting a chat request.

you can see email support or we can also chat with a support specialist

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker qualifies that chat support is not available for all publisher accounts.

evidence.quote: Not all publisher accounts can be supported via chat

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is instructional, explaining how publisher-account users can access Google support, select an issue category, and use email or chat. The video promotes MonetizeMore and says it provides full support access, but the available video evidence does not establish that this claim is deceptive. The contact details, product selection, and issue description are presented as parts of a Google support form, while chat availability is noted to vary by account.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an operational tutorial explaining how to navigate publisher-support pages, select a support category, and submit or initiate a support request.
